guidance.heading: Outlook Commentary
section: In the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects that shipments will decline sequentially by 6% to 8% from third quarter levels, reflecting three fewer business days and holiday-related seasonal softness. Average selling prices are expected to be flat to up by 2% quarter-over-quarter as higher carbon pricing is expected to slightly offset relative softening in stainless and aluminum pricing. Net sales are therefore expected to be in the range of $1.96 billion to $2.04 billion. Net income generation for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be in the range of $16 to $20 million, or $0.30 to $0.38 per diluted share, with LIFO expense between $28 and $32 million. Fourth quarter Adjusted EBITDA, excluding LIFO is expected to be in the range of $100 to $104 million, inclusive of Olympic Steel's expected contribution of $28 to $30 million.
